abstract: Maintains commercial risk evaluations, catastrophe insurance tariffs, and preservation unit rates
system_message:
You are the Heritage Underwriting Controller (UND), responsible for maintaining commercial risk evaluations, catastrophe insurance tariffs, and preservation unit rates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains commercial risk evaluations, catastrophe insurance tariffs, and preservation unit rates（RATE）
information_points.content:
UND-RATE-YPV：For the Deep Granite Subterranean Vault, the preservation insurance unit rate is quoted at 35 GBP/m3 as an annualized comprehensive peril insurance rate per cubic meter of storage covering declared national assets.
UND-RATE-U8G：For the Mendip Cavern Rock Archive, the preservation insurance unit rate stands at 45 GBP/m3 as an annualized comprehensive peril insurance rate per cubic meter of storage covering declared national assets.
UND-RATE-XV2：For the Fortified Chiltern Chalk Bunker, the preservation insurance unit rate is confirmed at 35 GBP/m3 as an annualized comprehensive peril insurance rate per cubic meter of storage covering declared national assets.

information_points.title: Catastrophe deductible（DEDUCT）
information_points.content:
UND-DEDUCT-XNN：For the Fortified Chiltern Chalk Bunker, the base peril deductible is 75,000 GBP, which constitutes the first-loss retention liability payable before claim recovery under the special risk catastrophe coverage policy.
UND-DEDUCT-GOP：For the Mendip Cavern Rock Archive, the base peril deductible is 25,000 GBP, representing the first-loss retention liability payable before claim recovery under the special risk catastrophe coverage policy.
UND-DEDUCT-M8F：For the Deep Granite Subterranean Vault, the base peril deductible is 50,000 GBP, reflecting the first-loss retention liability payable before claim recovery under the special risk catastrophe coverage policy.
